title: The four Labour Codes come into force
author: Editorial Desk
summary: On 21 November 2025 the Government brought the Codes into effect. BMS welcomed the move and called it support for workers.
body:
*Photo: BMS welcomes implementation of the Labour Codes*

After years of waiting, the Government of India announced on **21 November 2025** that the four Labour Codes, the Code on Wages, the Industrial Relations Code, the Code on Social Security and the OSH Code, had come into force.

## BMS response

Bharatiya Mazdoor Sangh **welcomed the implementation** and **extended support to the Government**, saying that the Codes benefit workers in the unorganised sector. It had been asking since earlier in the year that the Wage Code and the Social Security Code be implemented immediately.

## What changes for workers

- A **statutory right to minimum wages** for all, and a national floor wage.
- **Wider social security** coverage, including gig and platform workers.
- **Appointment letters** and an annual health check-up for certain workers.
- A **single registration and return** system for employers.

## What remains to be done

The Codes need **rules**, made by the Centre and the States, to be fully effective. BMS has also kept its objections to certain provisions of the Industrial Relations and OSH Codes, and has asked for further consultation. We report on that exchange in a later post.

## For the reader

If you work in an establishment covered by the Codes, ask for your appointment letter and wage slip. They are your first proof of rights.
